incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager duty alert — ZenithHealth (tenant: zenith) experiencing VPC auth failures on dedicated-pool-zh1. Spike in 401/502 from auth proxy. Incident created (INC-1769001023).
Maya Palmer: acked, I'm on call. Paging Alex Jordan for platform help.
Riley Chen: saw customer error in logs: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` from auth-proxy pods.
Carla Singh: sounds like mTLS handshake failing — probably missing intermediate in the cert chain after their rotation.
Devon Seo: Zenith support says they rotated certs yesterday and uploaded a new intermediate but might have omitted it in the bundle. They can re-upload if we ask.
Alex Jordan: quick checks: JWKS endpoint returns 200 but KID mismatch for a subset of tokens. TLS handshake logs show only leaf certificate — no intermediate.
Maya Palmer: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily relax strict mTLS on their dedicated auth proxy for traffic continuity 2) ask customer to re-upload full chain to their KMS 3) enable fallback routing for non-sensitive traffic to hosted cluster while we remediate.
Riley Chen: how do we flip fallback? Command: `redwood route set --tenant zenith --fallback hosted --reason "auth outage"`
Alex Jordan: can also add temporary allow-list for old key ID while they rotate JWKS. Will coordinate JWKS changes.
Maya Palmer: logs snippet from auth-proxy:
```
tls.HandshakeError: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
client_ip=10.1.2.3 tenant=zenith
```
Maya Palmer: I'm going to patch auth-proxy to set `MTLS_STRICT=false` for 10 minutes to reduce errors and buy time. Posting patch now.
Maya Palmer: patch command:
```
kubectl -n redwood-auth patch deploy auth-proxy-zh1 --patch='{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"auth-proxy","env":[{"name":"MTLS_STRICT","value":"false"}]}]}}}}'
```
Carla Singh: :lock: note we must record this change in the audit log and set an automatic TTL to revert. No permanent relaxation.
Maya Palmer: logged change under `incident:zenith-auth-relax` TTL=10m.
Devon Seo: Zenith rep says they can push the full chain within ~20 minutes.
Riley Chen: after the relax, error rate dropped from ~25% to ~1% on the dedicated pool. Some legacy clients still show 401s.
Alex Jordan: legacy clients may not trust the new CA. Short-term option: re-use previous intermediate if customer can provide it.
Devon Seo: they can't reissue older chain, but just uploaded the full chain to the support endpoint a few minutes ago.
Maya Palmer: confirming receipt of upload. Alex, can we safely allow a temporary KID allow-list?
Alex Jordan: yes, run:
```
redwood auth allow-key --tenant zenith --kid "old-kid-123" --ttl 1h
```
That will accept the old key for 1 hour while clients update.
Carla Singh: ensure we have a detection rule to auto-revert `MTLS_STRICT=true` after 15m and to revoke any allow-list keys after the TTL.
Maya Palmer: handoff note — I'm scheduled to hand off to Alex in 30 minutes. If issue resolved before then I'll close; otherwise escalate to eng-sre.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update — escalation to eng-sre triggered (if not acked by other responders).
Devon Seo: Zenith asked for a customer-facing ETA. Can we give 30–45 minutes?
Maya Palmer: yes, ETA 30–45. We have a fix path in progress.
Riley Chen: updated Zenith support channel with current status and ETA.
Maya Palmer: update: Zenith uploaded full chain and we reloaded proxy certs across the pool. Running smoke tests now.
Alex Jordan: confirmed via `openssl s_client -connect proxy.zenith.redwood:443 -showcerts` — full chain now present. Auth proxy logs no longer showing x509 errors.
Maya Palmer: rolling `MTLS_STRICT` back to true and removing the temporary allow-list. Commands executed:
```
kubectl -n redwood-auth patch deploy auth-proxy-zh1 --patch='{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"auth-proxy","env":[{"name":"MTLS_STRICT","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'
redwood auth revoke-allow --tenant zenith --kid "old-kid-123"
```
Carla Singh: audit entry created: id=INC-1769001023-zenith, includes change diff and who executed.
Devon Seo: Zenith confirms client dashboards show normal auth success rates. They appreciate the rapid response.
Maya Palmer: closing monitoring window for 1h. I'll handoff follow-up to Alex (postmortem + runbook updates). Creating ticket INTG-5421 for root cause: incomplete chain after cert rotation.
Alex Jordan: I'll take postmortem, coordinate with Zenith on guidance for cert bundle uploads (include chain verification steps + client compatibility notes).
Maya Palmer: final: issue resolved, monitoring stable. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident resolved. Duration ~38m. Posting SLO impact summary and next steps in INC-1769001023.
Carla Singh: added note — recommend adding automated chain validation on upload (validate full chain + match KID). Filing ENG-8572. :page_facing_up:
Devon Seo: Zenith requested a short note they can share with their ops team — I'll draft and send.
Alex Jordan: will follow up with a small runbook snippet for Dedicated pool operators.
Maya Palmer: handing off to Alex now. Handoff complete.
Riley Chen: :thumbsup:
